source: STOCKS: rreichel3/US-Stock-Symbols compact ticker lists (nasdaq/nyse/amex) -- COMPLETE common-stock universe. ETFs: Nasdaq Trader nasdaqlisted+otherlisted ETF=Y rows (only A-C retrieved; WebFetch truncated) + curated allowlist of ~230 major real ETFs. Names also enriched from SEC company_tickers.json (top ~1056 by mktcap) + GitHub full_tickers (partial).
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEATS: (1) Every large source truncated at WebFetch's ~79KB cap; only the compact per-exchange ticker lists and compact symbol arrays came through COMPLETE. (2) The rreichel3 lists are COMMON-STOCK-ONLY -- they contain essentially no ETFs (SPY/QQQ/VOO/GLD absent), because most US ETFs trade on NYSE Arca which those lists omit. ETF coverage here is therefore PARTIAL: authoritative ETFs only for the A-C alphabet slice that the Nasdaq Trader files returned before truncation, PLUS a curated allowlist of ~230 widely-traded ETFs (all real, verifiable tickers/names). ETFs whose ticker starts with D-Z and is not in the allowlist are MISSING. (3) Cleaning excluded preferred/series (^/$), warrants (/WS and paired W/WW suffixes), units, rights, and any name-confirmed Warrant/Unit/Right/Preferred/Depositary/Notes. (4) Class shares converted to Yahoo '-' format (e.g. BRK/A->BRK-A, BF/B->BF-B, AKO/A->AKO-A). (5) Stocks beyond the A-C name slice / non-megacaps use the ticker itself as a non-fabricated name placeholder -- Yahoo Finance returns the real long name at quote time. No symbols were fabricated.
